{{Quote|Welcome to your new post, ladies and gentlemen. Outpost DVL-181. We call in "The Quagmire".|Dek Laffer|<ref name="HS" />}}
'''Dek Laffer''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Laffer served at [[DVL-181]], a Rebel base on a swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
Laffer was a [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] and was based at outpost [[DVL-181]], located on a swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Laffer would sometimes welcome personnel who had been newly assigned to the outpost.<ref name="HS" />
